title: Knowledge Graph
description: Deterministic knowledge-graph contract (F059, extended by the F060 code layer per ADR-0025): the repository's knowledge corpus as a three-layer, six-verb graph shared by `amber knowledge graph --json` and the web knowledge surface. The graph is a pure function of the committed tree: stable order, no absolute paths, byte-identical on recompute. Every node and edge carries provenance; this deterministic layer emits only "deterministic" — "inferred" is reserved for the read-time LLM layer, which is never persisted. Read-time analytics (god nodes, communities, anomaly marks) are never part of these bytes.

schemaVersion.description: Graph schema version. Bumped on breaking shape changes (ADR-0012); version 2 admits Code Nodes and the imports/anchors verbs (ADR-0025).

toolchain.description: Extraction toolchain provenance: the exact compiler version behind the code layer, so a byte diff across environments is explainable (F060 determinism discipline).

nodes.description: Graph nodes in stable id order. Product source files enter as file-level Code Nodes (ADR-0025); test files stay out; artifacts enter at identity granularity.

id.description: Kind-prefixed node id, unique across the graph. Code Nodes use code:<POSIX path>.

layer.description: Three-layer ontology: decision (adr, artifact), knowledge (wiki, memory, architecture), implementation (feature, code).

updated.description: Content-recorded date (ADR Date line, wiki frontmatter) — never a scan-time clock.

sourcePath.description: Repo-relative source of the node (POSIX separators).

paths.description: Declared anchors. Still a node property; a declared path that is itself a Code Node additionally becomes an anchors edge (ADR-0025).

symbols.description: Exported-symbol table of a Code Node (never child nodes): 1-based positions, sorted by (startLine, startCol, name), deduplicated by name.

contextPage.description: Context page id merged into its source node as a property (ADR-0009).

body.description: Bounded Markdown/source excerpt from the node's canonical source (≤2000 chars). Present when canonical text is available: ADR/wiki/memory/architecture nodes use their source file text; feature nodes use the canonical feature_list.json fields (title, user_visible_behavior, verification, notes); artifact nodes use the head revision's committed body. Absent when no canonical text is available; Code Nodes carry no body — their symbols table is the excerpt.

revisions.description: Committed revision count for artifact nodes.

edges.description: Directed declarer -> declared edges in stable (src, verb, dst) order. Exactly six verbs: the four document verbs keep their F059 semantics; imports carries file-level code dependency (aggregated per file pair, never overloading references); anchors links feature -> code only when the declared path is a Code Node.

evidence.description: Where the declaring document names the target; for imports edges, each import statement in the declaring file.

drift.description: Dead-anchor findings attached to the declaring node, in stable (nodeId, path) order. A dead anchor never becomes a dangling edge (ADR-0025).

path.description: The declared anchor path absent from the tree.

actualPath.description: Detected actual path when a rename or directory collapse is recognized.
